column1: # TITLE: Loss of BRMS1 promotes a mesenchymal phenotype through regulation of Twist1

# SUMMARY: Analysis of BRMS1 KD-induced EMT in non-samll cell lung cancer at gene expression level. The hypothesis tested in the present study was that BRMS1 KD induces EMT through differential regulation of EMT genes and Twist1 KD restores the epithelial phenotype in cells with BRMS1 KD.
